_comment: Which Course Studio this repository expects. Under ADR-0005 the studio is a
sibling application built from our own fork, so this file names three things:
the fork commit our work sits on, the upstream commit it is level with, and
the image digest a deploy actually pulls.
The digest is the one that matters at deploy time. A commit says what the
source was; only a digest says what ran. `image.digest` is null until the
first image is published — a deploy must not proceed on a null.
Updating the studio is a decision, not a surprise: check_openmaic_contract.py
compares a checkout's HEAD against `commit` and reports the distance. It
reports; it does not force the move. Every rebase carries the DDL-drift risk
in OPENMAIC_INTEGRATION_V2_handoff.md §3.9, so bump `commit` and `verified`
only after a green pass — pg_dump, rebase, contract check, CI both sides.
`commit`/`commit_short`/`commit_date`/`verified`/`verified_against.locale_keys_en_us`
are read by check_openmaic_contract.py. Do not rename them without changing it.

fork.note: fork of THU-MAIC/OpenMAIC; our commits sit on top of upstream's real history

upstream.note: fork/main was fast-forwarded to this commit on 2026-09-10; no fork commits exist yet

image.note: phase 1 has not built one yet. A deploy must refuse a null digest rather than resolve a tag.

commit_subject: fix(ssrf): keep cloud metadata endpoints blocked under ALLOW_LOCAL_NETWORKS (#1419)

verified_against.upstream_gate: node scripts/check-i18n-keys.mjs — exact key alignment across the locale files

_comment: The name both sides must agree on. The gatekeeper sets it; the studio
reads it and turns it into an owner_id. Nothing else couples them.
A silent rename is the quietest failure this design has: no error, no
log line, the app keeps working, and every reader stops seeing their own
documents because the studio falls back to minting an anonymous owner
per browser. Pinning the name here is what turns that into a red check.
contract.studio_threaded_note: flip to true once the fork threads authenticatedOwnerId (phase 1, item 8). Until then the studio half of the assertion skips with a reason instead of failing for a known cause.
contract.base_path_note: The path the studio image was BUILT to serve under. NEXT_PUBLIC_STUDIO_BASE_PATH is compiled in, so this is a property of the image, not of the deployment. The compose overlay's STUDIO_BASE_PATH only builds the healthcheck URL and must equal this value: if they drift, the healthcheck probes a path the image does not serve, the container never reports healthy, and nothing says why.
